resources.string: Learn whichever key the head unit sends for next and previous track, answer or hang up, and CarPlay home. They act while CarPlay is connected; without a CarPlay session each key keeps the car’s own action.
Siri and play/pause have their own keys above. A key used there, or for map zoom or the joystick, cannot be learned here. During a call only the answer / hang-up key acts.
